title: Derived direct image for a morphism of ringed spaces
statement: Let $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,\mathcal B)$ be a morphism of ringed spaces [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The derived direct image $Rg_*:D(\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] is the total right derived functor of the additive direct-image functor $g_*$, computed by K-injective resolutions [def-pur-kinjective-complex, prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist] (the opens of $X$ form a site): if $K\to I$ is a K-injective resolution of a complex $K$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, then $Rg_*K$ is represented by the complex of $\mathcal B$-modules $g_*I$.
